sentence: On 7 July 2026 the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted accelerated approval to Trutakna (atacicept-vymj), an injection given under the skin.
note: Search text: accelerated approval, subcutaneous injection; news release dated July 7, 2026 per FDA rare disease list.

sentence: It is approved for adults with primary IgA nephropathy, a kidney disease, who are at risk of the disease getting worse.
note: Search text: 'adults with primary IgA nephropathy at risk of disease progression'. 'a kidney disease' is textbook-level.

sentence: The FDA describes it as the first approved medicine that targets both BAFF and APRIL, two signalling proteins involved in the survival and maturation of certain immune cells.
note: Search text: first FDA-approved medicine targeting BAFF and APRIL, proteins involved in survival and maturation of certain immune cells.

sentence: Accelerated approval here rests on a reduction in proteinuria, which means protein in the urine.
note: Search text: approval rests on reduction in proteinuria. Gloss is textbook.

sentence: The FDA states that it has not been established whether Trutakna slows the decline in kidney function over the long term, and that an ongoing trial must be completed to confirm this.

sentence: The efficacy and safety data come from a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in adults with biopsy-confirmed IgA nephropathy.
